715320101.text: Esteemed guests, I, the apprentice Storyteller Juanshu, must humbly request you cease your steps for a moment—

715320102.text: Perhaps you have heard a tale that goes something like this? "In the beautiful night of Lantern Rite, flaming lights once danced across the sky like glowing brushes, like a majestic scroll..."

715320103.text: Uh, Paimon didn't quite catch that.

715320104.text: Flaming lights? Painting in the sky? That's not something ordinary people can do... Even if you had some kinda airship, there's no kind of mysterious paint that can just hang in the air like that.

715320105.text: Sounds like a seriously exaggerated analogy!

715320108.text: #Anyway! The protagonists of this tale are none other than you two, the renowned {NICKNAME} whose fame has spread throughout the land, and {M#his}{F#her} companion Paimon!

715320109.text: Huh? Why is it suddenly about us?

715320110.text: Perhaps you have already forgotten, but this time last year, you accepted a commission from the Adventurer Tiantian and participated in a special speedrun challenge.

715320111.text: That speedrun challenge was illuminated by the glow of fireworks! A sight most majestic, a splendorous scene not oft seen!

715320112.text: Now that you mention it, Paimon kinda remembers that we helped some promoter from the Adventurers' Guild... It was nothing, really...

715320113.text: She said she wanted to use the event to recruit new members — no idea if it actually worked, though.
